name: Witcher Online
author: brainshead@gmail.com
description:
Witcher Online Server using https://www.nexusmods.com/witcher3/mods/11590.
Witcher Online is a mod that adds multiplayer to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, turning your single player experience into an MMO experience. Join servers to play with your friends, customize your character using Custom Player Characters and relax in taverns using Chill Out. Chat with strangers and perform emotes to roleplay with other players. Complete quests and play through the entire story together. Play Gwent and join parties with other players. The focus of this mod is to allow you to see other players on their adventure exploring throughout the world. A non-pirated copy of the latest version of Next Gen, Steam or GOG version 4.04+ is required.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
    set -euo pipefail

    trap 'echo; echo "ERROR: Installation failed."; echo "Line: $LINENO"; echo "Command: $BASH_COMMAND"' ERR

    echo "========================================="
    echo " Witcher Online Server Installer"
    echo "========================================="

    apt-get update -y
    apt-get install -y curl jq unzip p7zip-full ca-certificates

    cd /mnt/server

    GAME_DOMAIN="${GAME_DOMAIN:-witcher3}"
    MOD_ID="${MOD_ID:-11590}"
    DOWNLOADED=false
    ARCHIVE=""

    echo
    echo "Checking for installation archive..."

    ARCHIVE=$(find . -maxdepth 1 \( -iname "*.zip" -o -iname "*.7z" -o -iname "*.rar" \) | head -n1 | sed 's#^\./##')

    if [ -z "$ARCHIVE" ]; then
        echo "No local archive found."

        if [ -z "${NEXUS_API_KEY:-}" ]; then
            echo
            echo "ERROR: No archive was uploaded and no Nexus API key was provided."
            exit 1
        fi

        echo
        echo "Retrieving Nexus file list..."

        FILE_ID=$(curl -fsSL \
            -H "apikey: $NEXUS_API_KEY" \
            -H "accept: application/json" \
            "https://api.nexusmods.com/v1/games/$GAME_DOMAIN/mods/$MOD_ID/files.json" |
            jq -r '.files | map(select(.name|test("^Witcher Online Server";"i"))) | max_by(.uploaded_timestamp) | .file_id')

        [ -z "$FILE_ID" ] || [ "$FILE_ID" = "null" ] && { echo "Unable to determine latest file."; exit 1; }

        echo "Using File ID: $FILE_ID"
        echo
        echo "Requesting Nexus download link..."

        HTTP=$(curl -sS -w "%{http_code}" -o response.json \
            -H "apikey: $NEXUS_API_KEY" \
            -H "accept: application/json" \
            "https://api.nexusmods.com/v1/games/$GAME_DOMAIN/mods/$MOD_ID/files/$FILE_ID/download_link.json")

        if [ "$HTTP" != "200" ]; then
            echo
            echo "Automatic download is unavailable."
            echo

            if [ "$HTTP" = "403" ]; then
                echo "Nexus Mods Premium is required for API downloads."
            else
                cat response.json
            fi

            rm -f response.json

            echo
            echo "Download the archive manually, upload it to the server,"
            echo "then run the installer again."
            exit 1
        fi

        URL=$(jq -r '.[0].URI' response.json)
        rm -f response.json

        ARCHIVE=$(basename "${URL%%\?*}")
        curl --fail --location --progress-bar "$URL" -o "$ARCHIVE"
        DOWNLOADED=true
    else
        echo "Using local archive: $ARCHIVE"
    fi

    echo
    echo "Backing up existing installation..."

    BACKUP=".installer-backups/$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S)"
    mkdir -p "$BACKUP"

    find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 \
        ! -name ".installer-backups" \
        ! -iname "*.zip" \
        ! -iname "*.7z" \
        ! -iname "*.rar" \
        -exec mv {} "$BACKUP/" \;

    echo
    echo "Extracting $ARCHIVE..."

    case "${ARCHIVE,,}" in
        *.zip) unzip -o "$ARCHIVE" ;;
        *.7z|*.rar) 7z x "$ARCHIVE" -y ;;
        *) echo "Unsupported archive."; exit 1 ;;
    esac

    if [ "$DOWNLOADED" = true ]; then
        rm -f "$ARCHIVE"
    fi

    echo
    echo "Validating installation..."

    [ -f WitcherServer.jar ] || {
        echo "WitcherServer.jar not found."
        find . -maxdepth 2 -type f
        exit 1
    }

    echo
    echo "Installation complete."
